def process(reportsByType):
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType.copy()

    # Drop rows with missing numeric values (e.g., trailing footer/blank rows)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other'])

    # Ensure we are within 2001-2024 inclusive (already, but enforce)
    df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2001) & (df['Year'] <= 2024)]

    # If there are duplicate Year rows, sum them (shouldn't happen, but observed trailing 2024 NaNs)
    df = df.groupby('Year', as_index=False)[['Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']].sum()

    df['Total'] = df['Fraud'] + df['Identity Theft'] + df['Other']
    df['OtherShare'] = df['Other'] / df['Total']

    any_year = bool((df['OtherShare'] > 0.5).any())
    return pd.DataFrame([{'answer': 'Yes' if any_year else 'No'}])
